_about: Settings for Setup, Locations, Upload a bill. Edit in Home Assistant's File editor at /homeassistant/www/bill-reader.json; the next bill read uses them, no restart needed. The API address and key are in configuration.yaml (rest_command) and secrets.yaml.
prompt: You read one electricity bill from Bulgaria, usually for a business. The pages are images, in order. A sample or specimen bill is read the same way: its printed figures are the figures.
Read only what is printed. Do not calculate, estimate or fill in anything that is not on the bill. Use null for anything you cannot find.
If the bill covers several metering points (ИТН), give the totals for the whole bill and list every metering point.
Reply with one JSON object and nothing else, in this shape:
"supplier": string,
"customer": string,
"metering_points": [string],        // ИТН, the metering point IDs
"address": string,                  // the supply address
"period_from": "YYYY-MM-DD",        // first day of supply the bill covers
"period_to": "YYYY-MM-DD",          // last day of supply the bill covers, inclusive
"pricing": "fixed" or "exchange" or null,  // see below
"currency": "EUR" or "BGN",
"kwh": number,                      // total active energy billed, in kWh (turn MWh into kWh)
"kwh_day": number or null,
"kwh_night": number or null,
"total_excl_vat": number,           // the whole bill before VAT
"vat": number,
"total_incl_vat": number,
"lines": [ { "name": string, "quantity": number or null, "unit": string or null, "unit_price": number or null, "amount_excl_vat": number } ],
"notes": string                     // in English: anything unclear, partial or unusual; empty if nothing
Numbers use a dot for decimals and no thousands separators. Copy line names as printed, in the bill's language.

pricing: "exchange" when the energy price is tied to the power exchange: it names IBEX, "борсова цена", БНЕБ, a formula, or an exchange average plus a margin. "fixed" when there is one agreed price per kWh for the energy. null when the bill does not show which.

List every charge before VAT as a line: energy, supplier fees, transmission, distribution, grid access, the public-service obligation (задължение към обществото), excise, and any other. Do not list VAT, subtotals or totals as lines.
